scope: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT all delivery start states for one scenario, including region state construction and join; excludes client result transfer and data preparation
cache: verification, preflight and warmup; cache not cleared
postgres_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

input_snapshot.delivery_view:
SELECT s.scenario_id,
    d.delivery_id,
    d.region_id,
    d.started_at AS delivery_started_at,
    r.started_at AS state_started_at,
    r.finished_at AS state_finished_at,
    r.started_at IS NOT NULL AS state_known,
    r.alert_active,
    r.outage_active
   FROM scenario.definitions s
     JOIN core.fact_delivery d ON d.region_id = s.region_id AND d.started_at >= s.window_start AND d.started_at < s.window_end
     LEFT JOIN scenario.region_state r ON r.scenario_id = s.scenario_id AND r.region_id = d.region_id AND d.started_at >= r.started_at AND d.started_at < r.finished_at;
input_snapshot.region_view:
WITH valid_scenarios AS (
         SELECT s_1.scenario_id,
            s_1.region_id,
            s_1.window_start,
            s_1.window_end,
            s_1.description
           FROM scenario.definitions s_1
          WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM control.load_batch b
                  WHERE b.source_type = 'alerts'::text AND b.status = 'success'::text AND b.rows_accepted > 0 AND b.rows_accepted = (( SELECT count(*) AS count
                           FROM core.fact_alert)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM core.fact_alert a
                          WHERE a.load_id <> b.load_id))))
        ), events AS (
         SELECT s_1.scenario_id,
            GREATEST(a.started_at, s_1.window_start) AS started_at,
            LEAST(a.finished_at, s_1.window_end) AS finished_at,
            'alert'::text AS factor
           FROM valid_scenarios s_1
             JOIN core.fact_alert a ON a.region_id = s_1.region_id AND a.event_type = 'Повітряна тривога'::text AND a.started_at < s_1.window_end AND a.finished_at > s_1.window_start
        UNION ALL
         SELECT s_1.scenario_id,
            GREATEST(o.started_at, s_1.window_start) AS "greatest",
            LEAST(o.finished_at, s_1.window_end) AS "least",
            'outage'::text
           FROM valid_scenarios s_1
             JOIN scenario.outage_events o USING (scenario_id)
          WHERE o.started_at < s_1.window_end AND o.finished_at > s_1.window_start
        ), changes AS (
         SELECT events.scenario_id,
            events.started_at AS t,
            (events.factor = 'alert'::text)::integer AS da,
            (events.factor = 'outage'::text)::integer AS do_
           FROM events
        UNION ALL
         SELECT events.scenario_id,
            events.finished_at,
            - (events.factor = 'alert'::text)::integer,
            - (events.factor = 'outage'::text)::integer
           FROM events
        UNION ALL
         SELECT valid_scenarios.scenario_id,
            valid_scenarios.window_start,
            0,
            0
           FROM valid_scenarios
        UNION ALL
         SELECT valid_scenarios.scenario_id,
            valid_scenarios.window_end,
            0,
            0
           FROM valid_scenarios
        ), points AS (
         SELECT changes.scenario_id,
            changes.t,
            sum(changes.da) AS da,
            sum(changes.do_) AS do_
           FROM changes
          GROUP BY changes.scenario_id, changes.t
        ), active AS (
         SELECT points.scenario_id,
            points.t,
            lead(points.t) OVER w AS next_t,
            sum(points.da) OVER w AS alert_count,
            sum(points.do_) OVER w AS outage_count
           FROM points
          WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY points.scenario_id ORDER BY points.t ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
        ), segments AS (
         SELECT active.scenario_id,
            active.t,
            active.next_t,
            active.alert_count > 0::numeric AS alert_active,
            active.outage_count > 0::numeric AS outage_active
           FROM active
          WHERE active.next_t IS NOT NULL AND active.t < active.next_t
        ), changes_of_state AS (
         SELECT segments.scenario_id,
            segments.t,
            segments.next_t,
            segments.alert_active,
            segments.outage_active,
                CASE
                    WHEN lag(segments.alert_active) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM segments.alert_active OR lag(segments.outage_active) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM segments.outage_active THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS is_new
           FROM segments
          WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY segments.scenario_id ORDER BY segments.t)
        ), islands AS (
         SELECT changes_of_state.scenario_id,
            changes_of_state.t,
            changes_of_state.next_t,
            changes_of_state.alert_active,
            changes_of_state.outage_active,
            changes_of_state.is_new,
            sum(changes_of_state.is_new) OVER (PARTITION BY changes_of_state.scenario_id ORDER BY changes_of_state.t) AS island
           FROM changes_of_state
        )
 SELECT s.scenario_id,
    s.region_id,
    min(i.t) AS started_at,
    max(i.next_t) AS finished_at,
    i.alert_active,
    i.outage_active,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM max(i.next_t) - min(i.t)) AS duration_seconds
   FROM islands i
     JOIN valid_scenarios s USING (scenario_id)
  GROUP BY s.scenario_id, s.region_id, i.island, i.alert_active, i.outage_active;
